name: Non-Profit Coordinator

sections.daily_work: Manage programs, volunteers, and operations for non-profit organizations. Plan events, write grant proposals, coordinate outreach, and track program impact.
sections.learning: Program management, grant writing, volunteer coordination, fundraising, budgeting, community outreach, and impact measurement.
sections.pay: Varies by organization size and role. Entry-level often starts around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Degree in any field, volunteering with non-profits, internships in program management, building skills in grant writing and fundraising.

try_in_real_life: Volunteer with a local non-profit and observe how they operate
Draft a mock grant proposal for a cause you care about
Organize a small fundraising event for a community project
Research non-profit organizations in your area and their missions
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
